message: As a busy parent, I often find myself in the thick of things, juggling kids, snacks, and a seemingly endless to-do list. It’s easy to forget about being prepared for the unexpected — unless, of course, you’ve had that one hilarious moment where you realized you were woefully unprepared for a storm or a power outage. 🤦‍♀️ That’s why I found this resource for kids so useful; it’s all about making preparedness fun and engaging for our little ones! It’s a gentle reminder that a little planning can save us from the comedy of not being ready. What’s your favorite tip for getting your family involved in preparedness?
